archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: Diff adds Bash CLI paths and wrappers where sourcing/direct execution and macOS Bash 3.2 compatibility are central.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shell changes for Bash 3.2 compatibility, especially arithmetic, arrays, [[ usage, set -euo pipefail boundaries, and source-versus-exec guards. Check whether derived environment variables, usage exits, and stdout/stderr contracts behave consistently when invoked by absolute path or sourced by callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step5-runtime
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes /implement Step 5 runtime guidance and degraded-round counting, which can break orchestration if subtly mismatched.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine Step 5 banner and preflight logic and its integration with run-step5-review.sh, review-and-fix.sh, session-env precedence, and degraded-round counting. Look for mismatches between the skill text and the actual shell fences, including whether failures are surfaced or logged as required without creating a second counting path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: make-harness
archetypes.rationale: New harness targets, shard membership, and agent-lint reachability can silently fall out of repository-wide checks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the Makefile, agent-lint exclusions, sibling documentation stubs, and test-harness shard registration for the new and modified harnesses. Check that each new test has the expected target reachability and that shard coverage will not miss, duplicate, or misclassify the harness entries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: quiet-contract
archetypes.rationale: The append-execution-issue change depends on the repository's quiet-by-default key-value output contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the append-execution-issue changes against the quiet output contract, including emit_kv usage, failure envelopes, exit-code classes, and stdout versus stderr behavior. Check that the new USAGE line is limited to the intended usage-failure paths and that documentation and tests reflect the same contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
